opencore-amr:

32-bit:
./configure --prefix=$PREFIX --enable-static --disable-shared --disable-amrnb-encoder
make

64-bit:
./configure --prefix=$PREFIX --host=x86_64-w64-mingw32 --enable-static --disable-shared --disable-amrnb-encoder
make

----------------------------------------------
Speex:

32-bit:
./configure --prefix=$PREFIX --enable-sse --enable-static --disable-shared
make

64-bit:
./configure --prefix=$PREFIX --host=x86_64-w64-mingw32 --enable-sse --enable-static --disable-shared

----------------------------------------------
dav1d

Use the MinGW shell (MINGW32 or MINGW64) so Meson picks that architecture's gcc.
MSYS Meson refuses to run in a MinGW shell.

32-bit
export CC=gcc
export CXX=g++
meson setup build32 --prefix .. --buildtype release --default-library static -Denable_tools=false -Denable_examples=false -Denable_tests=false && ninja -C build32

64-bit
export CC=gcc
export CXX=g++
meson setup build64 --prefix .. --buildtype release --default-library static -Denable_tools=false -Denable_examples=false -Denable_tests=false && ninja -C build64

----------------------------------------------
gnutls & deps

PREFIX=/tmp/install

GMP:
32-bit
./configure --prefix=$PREFIX --disable-shared --build=i686-w64-mingw32 --host=i686-w64-mingw32

64-bit
./configure --prefix=$PREFIX --disable-shared --build=i686-w64-mingw32 --host=x86_64-w64-mingw32


NETTLE:
Nettle 4 no longer accepts --with-include-path or --with-lib-path. Point the compiler at the GMP prefix instead.

32-bit
CPPFLAGS="-I$PREFIX/include" LDFLAGS="-L$PREFIX/lib" ./configure --prefix=$PREFIX --disable-shared --enable-static --disable-documentation --build=i686-w64-mingw32 --host=i686-w64-mingw32

64-bit
CPPFLAGS="-I$PREFIX/include" LDFLAGS="-L$PREFIX/lib" ./configure --prefix=$PREFIX --disable-shared --enable-static --disable-documentation --build=i686-w64-mingw32 --host=x86_64-w64-mingw32

GNUTLS:
Rebuild GnuTLS when Nettle changes. 3.8.13 is the current release and it links Nettle 4.

32-bit
GMP_CFLAGS="-I$PREFIX/include" GMP_LIBS="-L$PREFIX/lib -lgmp" PKG_CONFIG_PATH=$PREFIX/lib/pkgconfig/ ZLIB_CFLAGS=" " ZLIB_LIBS="-lz" ./configure --prefix=$PREFIX --disable-shared --enable-static --build=i686-w64-mingw32 --host=i686-w64-mingw32 --disable-cxx --disable-doc --disable-tools --disable-tests --with-included-libtasn1 --with-included-unistring --without-p11-kit --without-tpm --without-tpm2 --without-idn --without-brotli --without-zstd

64-bit
GMP_CFLAGS="-I$PREFIX/include" GMP_LIBS="-L$PREFIX/lib -lgmp" PKG_CONFIG_PATH=$PREFIX/lib/pkgconfig/ ZLIB_CFLAGS=" " ZLIB_LIBS="-lz" ./configure --prefix=$PREFIX --disable-shared --enable-static --build=i686-w64-mingw32 --host=x86_64-w64-mingw32 --disable-cxx --disable-doc --disable-tools --disable-tests --with-included-libtasn1 --with-included-unistring --without-p11-kit --without-tpm --without-tpm2 --without-idn --without-brotli --without-zstd

----------------------------------------------
libxml2

PREFIX=/tmp/install

FTP support is gone. Leave iconv and lzma out so the static library still needs only zlib.

32-bit
./configure --prefix=$PREFIX --disable-shared --enable-static --build=i686-w64-mingw32 --host=i686-w64-mingw32 --without-threads --without-python --without-http --without-iconv --without-lzma --with-zlib

64-bit
./configure --prefix=$PREFIX --disable-shared --enable-static --build=i686-w64-mingw32 --host=x86_64-w64-mingw32 --without-threads --without-python --without-http --without-iconv --without-lzma --with-zlib
